modal_remotebasedir_shortdesc:
1. The plugin will NOT automatically move content from the old directory to the new one on the remote. Everything syncs from the beginning again.
2. If you leave the field empty, the config will be reset to "Obsidian" (the default folder).
3. Special characters like '?', '/', '\' are not allowed. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed.
modal_remotebasedir_invaliddirhint: Your input contains special characters like '?', '/', '\' which are not allowed.
modal_remotebasedir_notice: New remote base directory config saved!
modal_remoteprefix_s3_shortdesc:
1. The plugin will NOT automatically move content from the old prefix to the new one on the remote. Everything syncs from the beginning again.
2. If you leave the field empty, files will be saved at the root of the bucket.
3. Special characters like '?', '/', '\' are not allowed. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed.
modal_remoteprefix_s3_invaliddirhint: Your input contains special characters like '?', '/', '\' which are not allowed.
modal_remoteprefix_s3_secondconfirm_empt: The prefix is empty and the files will be saved at the root of the bucket.
modal_syncconfig_attn:
Attention 1/2: This only syncs (copies) the whole Obsidian config dir, not other starting-with-dot folders or files. Except for ignoring folders .git and node_modules, it also doesn't understand the meaning of sub-files and sub-folders inside the config dir.
Attention 2/2: After the config dir is synced, plugins settings might be corrupted, and Obsidian might need to be restarted to load the new settings.
If you agree to take your own risk, please click the following second confirm button.
modal_qr_shortdesc:
This exports (partial) settings.
You can use another device to scan this QR code.
Or, you can click the button to copy the special URI and paste it into another device's VicSync Import Setting.
modal_qr_button_notice: The URI is copied to the clipboard!
modal_sizesconflict_title: VicSync: Conflicts found while skipping large files
modal_sizesconflict_desc:
You've set skipping files larger than {{thresholdMB}} MB ({{thresholdBytes}} bytes).
But the following files have sizes larger than the threshold on one side, and sizes smaller than the threshold on the other side.
To avoid unexpected overwriting or deleting, the plugin stops, and you have to manually deal with at least one side of the files.
modal_sizesconflict_copynotice: All size conflict info has been copied to the clipboard!

settings_autorun_desc: Automatically sync on a recurring timer while Obsidian is open.
settings_runoncestartup_desc: Automatically run a sync once after Obsidian starts up.
settings_synconsave_desc: Automatically trigger a sync shortly after modifying a note.
settings_skiplargefiles_desc: Skip files larger than the threshold (1 MB = 10^6 bytes).
settings_ignorepaths_desc: One regex per line matching relative vault paths (without leading slash) to exclude from sync.
settings_onlyallowpaths_desc: One regex per line matching relative vault paths to allow. Leave empty to sync the entire vault.
settings_enablestatusbar_info: Show Sync Status in Status Bar
settings_enablestatusbar_info_desc: Display the last sync time and live progress in the status bar.
settings_enablestatusbar_reloadrequired_: Reload the plugin for the changes to take effect.
settings_resetstatusbar_time_desc: Clear the last successful sync timestamp in the status bar.
settings_checkonnectivity_desc: Verify connection to the remote storage service.
settings_remotebasedir_desc: By default, vault files are synced inside a remote folder named "Obsidian". You can customize the remote folder name here.
settings_remoteprefix_s3_desc: By default in S3, files are saved at the root of the bucket. You can configure a folder prefix here.
settings_googledrive_disclaimer1: Syncs your vault directly with a folder in your Google Drive.
settings_googledrive_disclaimer2: Note: Native Google Docs/Sheets (.gdoc/.gsheet) inside the remote folder are automatically skipped.
settings_googledrive_revoke_desc: Connected to Google Drive. Click to remove saved credentials.
settings_googledrive_auth_desc: Authenticate with Google Drive using an OAuth Refresh Token.
settings_s3_disclaimer1: Syncs your vault with Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, or MinIO.
settings_s3_disclaimer2: Credentials are stored locally in your vault plugin configuration.
settings_s3_cors: If not bypassing CORS locally, allow requests from app://obsidian.md, capacitor://localhost, and http://localhost, and expose the ETag header.
settings_s3_prod2: Access Key ID and Secret Access Key info
settings_s3_region_desc: e.g., us-east-1 or auto (for Cloudflare R2).
settings_s3_bypasscorslocally_desc: Uses Obsidian's native requestUrl to bypass browser CORS restrictions.
settings_s3_parts_desc: Maximum parallel part uploads for large files.
settings_s3_accuratemtime_desc: Read accurate last-modified metadata (requires extra HEAD requests).
settings_s3_reverse_proxy_no_sign_url_de: Optional reverse proxy URL without http(s):// prefix.
settings_s3_generatefolderobject_desc: Whether to upload 0-byte '/' objects to represent folders in S3.
settings_s3_connect_succ: Great! The S3 bucket is accessible.
settings_s3_connect_fail: The S3 bucket cannot be reached.
settings_chooseservice_desc: Select Google Drive (primary) or S3-compatible storage (backup).
settings_concurrency_desc: Maximum number of files to upload or download in parallel (default: 5).
settings_syncunderscore_desc: Include files or folders starting with an underscore '_' (e.g., _Archive).
settings_deletetowhere_desc: Where locally deleted files should be moved during sync.
settings_conflictaction_desc: How to resolve files modified on both local and remote since the last sync:
settings_conflictaction_smart_conflict: Smart Merge (3-way diff3 merge for Markdown)
settings_conflictaction_smart_conflict_d: Automatically merges non-overlapping line edits in Markdown notes using 3-way diff3 merge. If lines overlap or the file is binary, both versions are preserved safely via a .dup copy.
settings_cleanemptyfolder_desc: How to handle empty folders after syncing files.
settings_cleanemptyfolder_clean_both: Remove empty folders on both sides (default)
settings_protectmodifypercentage_desc: Abort sync if more than N% of vault files would be modified or deleted in a single run.
setting_syncdirection_desc: Choose how changes flow between your local vault and cloud storage:
setting_syncdirection_incremental_push_o: Incremental Push (backup only, no remote deletions)
setting_syncdirection_incremental_pull_o: Incremental Pull (download only, no local deletions)
setting_syncdirection_incremental_push_a: Mirror Push (push changes & deletions to remote)
setting_syncdirection_incremental_pull_a: Mirror Pull (pull changes & deletions from remote)
settings_enablemobilestatusbar_desc: Show the status bar on Obsidian Mobile.
settings_export_desc: Export settings via QR code or URI.
settings_import_desc: Paste an exported vicsync:// URI here and click Import.
settings_import_error_notice: Your URI string is empty or invalid!
settings_cleardupfiles_desc: Scan your local vault for duplicate conflict files (.dup. or Google Drive (1).md suffixed duplicates) and remove them.
settings_debuglevel_desc: Set to "debug" for verbose sync output in the developer console.
settings_outputsettingsconsole_desc: Print the active plugin configuration to the developer console.
settings_viewconsolelog_desc: On macOS, press Cmd+Option+I to open the developer console. Errors are also automatically logged to _vicsync_debug.md in your vault root.
settings_syncplans_desc: Export recent sync plans to _debug_remotely_save/ in your vault.
settings_delsyncplans_desc: Delete stored sync plans from local IndexedDB.
settings_delprevsync_desc: Clear previous sync records in local DB so all files are treated as newly created on next sync.
settings_profiler_results_desc: Export timing breakdown of sync steps.
settings_profiler_enableprofiler_desc: Record timing metrics for each sync step.
settings_profiler_enabledebugprint_desc: Log step timings in real time to the console.
settings_profiler_recordsize_desc: Measure memory size of sync metadata structures.
settings_outputbasepathvaultid_desc: Print the vault base path and internal vaultRandomID to the console and notice.
settings_resetcache_desc: Drops the entire local IndexedDB cache (does not erase your Google Drive or S3 credentials). Reload Obsidian afterward.
settings_resetcache_notice: Local database cache deleted. Please reload Obsidian.
